description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle and Urza trigger.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct creature token.
Resolve the Teleportation Circle trigger, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Construct, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
